C1_dependencies.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.map
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The pushforward of a measure. It is defined to be `0` if `f` is not an almost everywhere
measurable function. -/
noncomputable
irreducible_def map [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (f : α → β) (μ : Measure α) :
    Measure β :=
  if hf : AEMeasurable f μ then mapₗ (hf.mk f) μ else 0

@[to_additive]
lemma Group.isUnit [Group α] (a : α) : IsUnit a :=
  ⟨⟨a, a⁻¹, mul_inv_cancel _, inv_mul_cancel _⟩, rfl⟩
